title: Andorid Biscuit Manager App Feature Requests.
summary: Of topic post, sorry, I could not find a project holder for the Android "Biscuit Manager" app for feature requests or bug reports.... Feature request: Please allow the option of 'track up' for the war driving map with a switch to select the current 'north up' map. Not having the map rotate to show the direction of travel at the top is beyond frustrating for some of us. Please allow the option to remember the last war drive type. I always select Wifi Only and the default "All" requires a tedious finger dance every single time (either remember or have a war driving type option in the settings menu).
